question: What conduct should be abandoned once practice yields an even mind?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind.
Village duty is named as something to relinquish.
The verse gives a prescriptive injunction.
inference: Through practice, one with an even mind should abandon conventional village duty.
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer broadly to worldly or social obligations.
plain_english: Through practice, when the mind becomes even, one should abandon the duties of village life.
